original.target_description: Experiment 2, acceptability ratings of yes/no continuations for cognitive versus emotive factives. The supplied p. 14 locator (printed p. 380) contains the no-rating contrast and predicate-type × answer-type interaction; the yes-rating contrast starts on PDF-text page 13 (printed p. 379). The neutral description does not distinguish these tests or simple versus expanded models.

n.sample_role: Participants; 62 is the stated Experiment 2 participation count, retained only as a candidate, not established target-model analytic N.
n.exclusions: Models include experimental-item data only; filler items excluded. Participant-level exclusions and the critical-model participant count are not explicitly stated in the inspected Experiment 2 methods/results.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text opens with Cognitive vs. emotive factives: An experimental differentiation and credits Kajsa DJÄRV, Jérémy ZEHR, and Florian SCHWARZ; page footers identify Proceedings of Sinn und Bedeutung 21. It is a primary research report with two experiments, methods/results, discussion, and references, rather than an abstract or secondary account. Title/authors/series match the neutral original reference. Publication year and DOI are not explicitly verified from the document heading; the reference DOI field djaerv_2018 is not a printed DOI. Supplied source_pdf_path is null, so no PDF was available for layout verification and no network acquisition was attempted. Only original unfinished fields are assessed; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Target ambiguity: Study 2 and the topic identify the experiment, but p. 14 and the broad description do not select the yes-rating main contrast, no-rating main contrast, or predicate-type × answer-type interaction, or model specification. Printed simple-model candidates: yes-ratings t = 4.954, b = 0.76, SE = 0.1534; no-ratings t = 0.625, b = 0, 1005, SE = 0.1607 (canonical punctuation retained; not repaired without PDF); interaction t = 4.083, b = 0.8605, SE = 0.2108. These are printed b coefficients; standardisation is not established, so none is relabelled beta (std). No p value or p bound is printed for these Experiment 2 contrasts; no p is derived from t. The count 62 is a common participant-count candidate only; no analytic N is inferred from recruitment, items, or test statistics, and no N sum is performed.
